articles.title: EarFun Launches Wave Pro X Dual-Driver Qualcomm ANC Headphones
articles.description: EarFun has announced the Wave Pro X, the company’s new flagship over-ear, dual-driver Qualcomm ANC headphones with Auracast support. Built around the QCC3095 platform, the Bluetooth 6.0 design features adaptive hybrid ANC, in a coaxial dual-driver acoustic system with an 8-microphone array. The company promotes it as a premium-but-accessible launch, which will also appeal to music enthusiasts with lossless playback and wide codec support, and a claimed 90-hour battery life.
